description: This source file defines an immutable implementation of the AuthorizationContext interface, named ImmutableAuthorizationContext. It provides methods to create instances from parameters or JSON, access authorization subjects and their IDs, add subjects, check authorization, and serialize to JSON. It also includes several static factory methods and internal logic for caching subject IDs.

classes.name: ImmutableAuthorizationContext
classes.description: Immutable implementation of AuthorizationContext, providing factory methods, JSON serialization, and collection operations on authorization subjects.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an ImmutableAuthorizationContext with a given type and list of subjects, ensuring immutability.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs an ImmutableAuthorizationContext from a JSON object, deserializing fields accordingly.

methods.name: getAuthorizationSubjects
methods.description: Returns the list of authorization subjects.

methods.name: getAuthorizationSubjectIds
methods.description: Returns a cached, unmodifiable list of IDs of the authorization subjects.

methods.name: getFirstAuthorizationSubject
methods.description: Returns the first authorization subject wrapped in an Optional, if any.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of authorization subjects.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if there are no authorization subjects.

methods.name: addHead
methods.description: Returns a new context with provided subjects added at the beginning.

methods.name: addTail
methods.description: Returns a new context with provided subjects added at the end.

methods.name: isAuthorized
methods.description: Checks if the context is authorized given granted and revoked subject collections.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the context to a JSON object according to the schema version.
